notes.title: Ergo - New Beta build 24/01/2024
notes.content:
This update is linked to the Beta Branch, this does not effect the default branch

- New Main Menu (prettier)
- New Menu interface (better programmed with lots of buttons)
- Fixed several soft locks in early and late game levels
- Replaced one of the characters dialogue with A.E.I.O.U (Temp)
- Massively improved all UV's of objects
- Improved visuals
- Improved Keypad
- Fixed a bug where Keycard readers wouldn't read
- Fixed a bug where Keypad notes wouldn't note
- Improved performance
- Removed T-Posing mannys in some areas (whoops)
- Removed Trinket system (Unfun, Achievements stay for now as they're still acquirable in default branch)
- Improved models
- Improved Door code (Currently only applies to the menu)
- Keypads can now generate up to 10 digits
- Keypad keys are now physical
- Keypads now play notes depending on the key value
- Keycards now have a black outline to make them easier to find on the floor
- Better lighting

That's all for now!

- Rowan H

notes.title: Rewrite Update On Hold
notes.content:
Hello, first off I'd like to apologise for putting this update on hold. I've been looking at development completely wrong, focusing on small gimmicks instead of the actual game.


 Lack of motivation
 Project Scale
 Upgrading player base
 Lack of time


I am currently working full time and can only really work around 1-2 hours a day on this project

Here's the plan going forward:

The plan is to go back to working with Ergo Legacy, the plan is to do the following.


 Improve the game piece by piece
 Block out and prototyping levels
 Improving the gameplay and challenge


Because of the lower fidelity of Ergo Legacy it will allow development time to speed up.

The Ergo Rewrite update is still planned, it just won't be happening anytime soon.

Remember, purchase a game based on what it is, not what it could eventually be.

Thank you

- Rowan H

notes.title: Upcoming Beta builds
notes.content:
April Fools! Just kidding, this ones legit, I just thought it'd be funny to announce something on April 1st. So first things first, the plan.

Firstly, I want to talk about how you will be able to play these beta builds.

When they're ready, I'll be modifying how Ergo launches, the current build will be reverted back to a build with no unfinished features, this will be done just to make the game look prettier for the time being. When you try to launch the game you will be greeted with launch options (As is the case for SteamVR and OculusVR) You will be able to play the Original Ergo and the Redesigned Ergo (they will both be installed when the upcoming build is ready).

Please keep in mind, Redesigned Ergo is early in development and reporting bugs and glitches will greatly help with the process.

Secondly here's some screenshots. The game is coming along nicely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40642259/2f1aa1f414b0c5d7b5d4da30b357eba896b39532.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40642259/2ed9b287a18c2d3158cbaa38e6950bcfc3a5fb3c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40642259/7b1112ed501718a52666779f09da9869ff9ebd23.png

Thirdly, the game's story. It will still follow the same path as the original Ergo's but will have some changes to make the game more exciting, fun and worth revisiting.

Finally the store page. This will not be updated until there's enough content for Redesigned Ergo to stand on its own. However, I will provide you with the description and what it looks like so far.

Welcome to Ergo HQ. After being mistaken for someone else, you play as Joseph Phillips; a new intern who is sent into Virtual Reality to "test" experimental equipment within the Ergoverse; an abandoned Metaverse application, reconstructed by a single man and his AI workers. 

Will you be worthy of joining Ergo HQ full time?

Features


 Made with VRGK
Ergo uses VR Game Kit, which allows us to create more complex experiences within VR, this allows for some of the best VR Gameplay available at the moment.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40642259/61670e89bd4abd4ea855c2f42bd3f16013595873.gif
 Fullbody Character
Alongside these advanced mechanics, we have a full-body physics-based character, Which feels natural and satisfying to control and exist within the world we have constructed. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40642259/ed49685545d95d08a35711132c2ed360d76ecb6d.gif
 Interactive World
Items within the world are physical, with realistic interactions and weight, allowing environments to feel that much more real.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40642259/f559abddcab626d7299a35fb275b47b4be78ac3a.gif


Finally, my send off (for now)

I hope my giant wall of text can satisfy you all for the time being, it's been a blast to work on Ergo and when the Redesigned build is ready, it will be [strike]the game of all time[/strike] See you soon!

- Rowan H

notes.title: An Update
notes.content:
Its been a while hasn't it?

I've been focused on reworking the story and level design, lets be honest. It could definitely be better

Ergo was mainly developed as a simple puzzle game made similar to most VR games releasing at the time. While I felt proud of the game at the time, as per every developer, they eventually stop enjoying what they had made.

I'm not giving up here, while I am proud of what Ergo was, being an impressive (but simple) VR Game, I'd like to step out of my comfort zone.

So here's the plan

The game will be getting its VRGK 3.0 Patch, sometime in 2023, It'll be a separate Beta Branch (With new levels being added whenever ready) , until it's finished, it'll stay that way.

From what's been done so far, It needs the following:

Story Rework
Complete Puzzle Overhaul
Better Voice Acting
More Characters
Less Depressing
More Fun Mechanics
Visual Overhaul


I apologise for the lack of communication. Hopefully some VERY EARLY screenshots of the rework will make up for it, including a look at the new menu and logos :)

Until next time

-Rowan H

notes.title: Small Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello, apologies for the lack of updates but I've been very busy with work and haven't had time to work on Ergo, I've made a list of stuff I plan to get out for the next update

Ergo will be getting ported to VRGK 3.0, Ergo currently runs on VRGK 2.0, i've seen the improvements with 3.0 and I know it's a must for Ergo, better performance and cool systems and mechanics which'll make the playing experience more unique.

this will take some time as I am VERY busy with work and 3.0 hasn't released yet.

Some parts of the game... nicest thing to say, they suck, so i'll be attempting to ramp up the challenge or replacing them altogether

I have many plans for this game, expect more in 2023!


I'm also happy to take suggestions

- Rowan H

notes.title: Ergo Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello, i'd like to start by apologising for delaying Ergo for several months, while this was never the plan it was necessary. Now for the main points.


Ergo is coming to steam on May 9th 2022
It will be in early access as the game isn't complete
The game contains Budget voice acting (This is out of my control as a solo dev)
 The game will retail for the following prices $6.99, £5.19, €5,69


What will the game contain in Early Access?

The game contains the following


All 19 playable levels, All of these levels are not finalised and may be drastically changed following player feedback
Save system, This saves the last played level.
Level select, Levels can be replayed after the player has completed them
Spectator camera, enabled by default, this can be disabled within the settings
Hidden Trinkets, finding all the trinkets in the level will reward the player with extra rooms / content on the main menu (Not ready for EA, however stats will be saved so, no fear of having to find them all again!)
Randomised visuals, Items like Monitors, Chairs, Desks, etc can appear with different models/textures every playthrough!
 Graphics settings, allowing for adjustments for the best visuals or performance
 Gameplay settings, want to move with your left hand, right hand or use your head, want smooth turn, want to turn fast or slow, all changeable here!
 Audio settings, game too loud, sound too annoying or voice acting to budget? lower or disable the audio entirely!


What's planned before leaving Early Access?


 Bug fixes
 Framerate improvements
 Level adjustments
 Level improvements
 Secrets
 Subtitles
 More areas to explore
 Rewards, related to the Trinket System
 Player feedback
 And much more!



I hope you're looking forward to Ergo's release; This has been a long time in the making and I'm hoping to continue development using your feedback / suggestions.

- Rowan H
